item.title: Rubbing penis against child’s private part not ‘Penetrative Sexual Assault’ under POCSO Act; Delhi HC modifies sentence
item.description: “The accused in this case was a doctor to whom the child was sent for medicine. The accused was in a position of authority and trust, and it was such a position that had been misused by him… In such circumstances, no leniency is called for.” The post Rubbing penis against child’s private part not ‘Penetrative Sexual Assault’ under POCSO Act; Delhi HC modifies sentence appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: “Section 498A IPC not panacea for all matrimonial ills”: Karnataka High Court quashes FIR against husband and his family
item.description: “Minor skirmishes that happens in the family between the husband and the wife are projected to become a crime for offences punishable under Section 498A of the IPC or even under Section 504 IPC” The post “Section 498A IPC not panacea for all matrimonial ills”: Karnataka High Court quashes FIR against husband and his family appeared first on SCC Times.

item.description: The post Romeo Juliet Clause : Decode SC’s POCSO Judgment appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi HC enforces Amit Malviya’s undertaking; Stays defamation complaint against RSS Member
item.description: Amit Malviya had filed a criminal defamation complaint before the Patiala House Court against Santanu Sinha, a Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (‘RSS’) member, regarding Facebook posts made by him. The post Delhi HC enforces Amit Malviya’s undertaking; Stays defamation complaint against RSS Member appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Personal appearance of accused before appellate/revisional court on every date after suspension of sentence & grant of bail not warranted: Supreme Court
item.description: “The proper course is to proceed with the appeal on merits, ensuring representation, while securing presence only in accordance with law upon dismissal or as otherwise required." The post Personal appearance of accused before appellate/revisional court on every date after suspension of sentence & grant of bail not warranted: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Overview of Environmental (Protection) Fund Rules, 2026
item.description: Environment Ministry has notified the Environmental Protection Fund Rules, 2026, which govern the collection, allocation, and utilization of environmental penalties. The post Overview of Environmental (Protection) Fund Rules, 2026 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi Court convicts Dukhtaran-e-Millat Chief Asiya Andrabi & associates for promoting secession of Kashmir – Full Judgment Explained
item.description: “They have been vociferously endorsing, supporting, and promoting the sentiments as well as provoking the people of Kashmir. So much so, in their posts, the accused have called for a boycott of elections and to reject the candidate who comes with the idea of development.” The post Delhi Court convicts Dukhtaran-e-Millat Chief Asiya Andrabi & associates for promoting secession of Kashmir – Full Judgment Explained appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: 1st NLIU-CAM Certificate Course on Labour & Employment Laws, 2026
item.description: NLIU Bhopal, in collaboration with Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, announces the 1st NLIU—CAM Certificate Course on Labour & Employment Laws, 2026, focusing on the future of work and labour law reforms. item.title: Orissa High Court bars application of Limitation Act computation method to contractual termination clauses
item.description: “Whether the termination would take effect from a particular date has no nexus to the period provided for issuance of the notice.” The post Orissa High Court bars application of Limitation Act computation method to contractual termination clauses appeared first on SCC Times.
